config.tagline: 100% Pure Kadaknath Eggs, Chicks & Live Meat Chicken Available Direct at Farm
config.address: Plot No 85/B, KVR Sakthidhar, Near Chelluru Highway, Vizianagaram 535005

eggs.name: Desi / Country Eggs (Nattu Kozhi)
eggs.description: Pure free-range country eggs laid by traditional desi hens. Rich deep yellow yolk, high nutritional value, no artificial growth hormones.

eggs.name: Farm Fresh White Eggs (Table Eggs)
eggs.description: Freshly collected daily from bio-secure layer farms. High protein, clean shell, carefully graded for size and quality.

eggs.name: Organic Brown Layer Eggs
eggs.description: Strong shelled brown eggs from grain-fed layer birds. Rich in Omega-3 and natural vitamin D, perfect for daily family breakfast.

eggs.name: Desi Fertile Hatching Eggs
eggs.description: High fertility rate (85%+) eggs specially collected for incubator hatching. Tested parent stock bred for disease resistance.

chicks.name: Day-Old Country Chicks (Desi / Kadaknath)
chicks.description: Healthy, active day-old country chicks. Mareks & Ranikhet (ND) vaccinated at hatchery. High survival rate and fast feathering.

chicks.name: Commercial Broiler Chicks (Cobb 500 / Ross 308)
chicks.description: Fast-growing commercial broiler chicks with excellent Feed Conversion Ratio (FCR). Ready for market weight in 38-42 days.

chicks.name: High Yield Layer Chicks (BV300)
chicks.description: Female layer chicks bred for top egg production. Capable of laying up to 320+ eggs per year with minimal feed consumption.

chicks.name: 3-Week Grown Country Pullet Chicks
chicks.description: Fully brooding phase completed! Strong immunity, out of mortality risk window. Ready for open backyard or farm coop rearing.

chicks.name: 6-Week Grown Layer Pullets
chicks.description: Robust grown pullets, fully feathered with strong skeletal frame. Near laying age (starts laying at 18-20 weeks). Zero brooding needed.

chicks.name: 2-Week Started Broiler Birds
chicks.description: Well-established started broiler chicks past starter phase. Rapid weight gain guaranteed with balanced starter feed.
